experiences.title: Senior Software Engineer
experiences.subtitle: Ecovacs Robotics
workDescription: Led a group of 8 to build over a dozen backend applications, including NLP systems, IoT platforms, image processing, data pipeline, and integration with Alexa and Google Assistant, supporting over 10 million users and devices.
Designed key architectural solutions focusing on distributed microservices, robust API design, and relational modeling, ensuring scalability, security, and 99.99% high availability.
Created service-oriented applications with Node.js, Go, Protocol Buffers, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Kafka, and Redis, handling peak concurrent requests of around 30,000 per second.
Integrated third-party AI interfaces and built a labeling system to train specialized business models based on the general models of cloud vendors, which increased the speech recognition rate by 7%.

Optimized product performance through refactoring from monolith to microservices, rewriting JavaScript core program with Go, offloading server computation to edge devices, and reducing interface latency by up to 90%.

Streamlined software release processes by utilizing tools like Git, Jenkins/GitHub Actions, SonarQube, and automated testing, ensuring efficient and error-free deployments, shortening deployment time by 2/3, and reducing errors by 70%.
Collaborated closely with cross-functional teams to identify and prioritize work items, delivering incremental software releases in 2-week sprints.
Mentored a team of 5 junior engineers, improving team effectiveness through pair coding, code reviews, and technology sharing.
